title: The silent-undo check's CLI reads the PR body, so a `Drops-lines:` line in the body clears it
why: lint/check_silent_undo.py's CLI never reads the PR body, so a `Drops-lines:` line in the body false-fails the lane lint (seen on #1785).
note: Fix: the CLI reads the body through merge's reader. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 04:33 CST Nov 8; lane notes-fix-page builds it (coordinator, 04:31 CST Nov 8). Held: decision silent-undo-check-design says the CLI and CI pass no PR body, so the lane raised it under the stale-decision protocol; page item 411 (drops-lines-body-everywhere) asks the owner (coordinator, 05:01 CST Nov 8). The builder waits on that answer. Owner item 411 a (06:11 CST Nov 8), the widening option, chosen over the recommended b: the silent-undo CLI reads a `Drops-lines:` PR body line through merge/merge.py's reader (env PR_BODY in CI, --pr-body locally); decision silent-undo-check-design is rewritten in place to say every reader takes the body. Hold lifted.
